name: vision_explain
title: An explainability and robustness report: Grad-CAM, FGSM and PGD, deterministic TTA and temperature calibration - evaluation code that legitimately needs gradients
origin: domain-vision round 2: the pure false-positive trap. Nothing in this workspace trains anything; three of its evaluation passes call backward(), one sets requires_grad_ on its input, and one fits a single parameter with LBFGS on the validation split

forbidden.why: THE TRAP, AND IT FIRES TODAY at high / 0.97 / certain (round-2 finding VIS2-12). TemperatureScaler.fit has no no_grad decorator, closure() has none, and nothing encloses it. What MLView is reacting to is the `with torch.enable_grad():` block inside fgsm/pgd/GradCAM earlier in the module - enable_grad is the context that ENABLES gradients, and docs/ISSUE_RULES.md MLV204 documents it as the negating context. Twelve-line repro in the report

THE TRAP, AND IT FIRES TODAY at 0.59 (round-2 finding VIS2-13). tta_accuracy calls model.eval() at line 94, immediately before the loop; tta_logits calls model.eval() again at explain.py:112, immediately before the forward the finding cites; and load_model returns model.to(device).eval(). The evidence line reads `no torch.nn.Module.eval() dominates this region`, which is false three times over
same (VIS2-13). robust_accuracy calls model.eval() at line 108 and fgsm/pgd each call model.eval() again before the forward the finding cites

THE TRAP: robust_accuracy has no no_grad decorator ON PURPOSE - FGSM and PGD need the gradient of the loss with respect to the input - and the one part that does not need a graph is wrapped in `with torch.no_grad():` at line 120. The rule's documented de-rate for evaluation that genuinely needs gradients covers exactly this
same for GradCAM.__call__, fgsm and pgd: a class-activation map IS a gradient
there is no sklearn transformer in this project

THE TRAP: TemperatureScaler.fit is fitted on the validation split, which is the documented calibration protocol - one scalar, and the test split is only ever transformed. There is no sklearn transformer here in any case
there is no training loader in this project - nothing trains
both loaders are built with shuffle=False
the loaders are built inside build_loaders(), reached only from main() under the __main__ guard
eval_transform() is Resize, CenterCrop and ToTensor - nothing random. The TTA views in tta_logits are a fixed, exhaustively averaged set, which is the documented deliberate-TTA guard
THE TRAP: the only optimizer is the LBFGS in TemperatureScaler.fit, whose closure calls optimizer.zero_grad(set_to_none=True) first - and LBFGS is the documented skip anyway
THE TRAP: GradCAM, fgsm and pgd all back-propagate to produce a map or a perturbation, not to update parameters. There is no optimizer in the file for them to step, and there should not be one
optimizer.step(closure) is the LBFGS protocol; the backward happens inside the closure it is given
expected_calibration_error reduces every tensor with .item() before it accumulates, and tta_logits accumulates under @torch.no_grad()
every accumulator in report.py adds .item() or a Python int
there is no learning-rate scheduler in this project
there is no GradScaler and no autocast in this project
GradCAM.__call__, fgsm, pgd and tta_logits each call model.eval() as their first statement
every accuracy is computed after argmax(dim=1), and the calibration error is computed on softmax probabilities by design
no ranking metric is computed anywhere
THE TRAP: F.softmax in tta_logits produces the averaged probabilities that are argmax-ed; it never reaches F.cross_entropy, which is fed model(perturbed) logits directly in fgsm and pgd
the softmax calls in calibration_report feed the calibration error, not a loss
there is no sigmoid and no BCE loss in this project
load_model moves the model with .to(device) and every batch is moved inside every loop
pick_device() checks torch.cuda.is_available()
seed_everything() seeds random, numpy, torch and torch.cuda
there is no split in this project - val/ and test/ are separate directories
TemperatureScaler calls super().__init__() first; GradCAM is not an nn.Module
ResNetClassifier calls super().__init__() first
there is no plain list or dict of submodules anywhere
torch.load passes map_location="cpu", weights_only=True; nothing is saved
